audit.result: accepted with one corrected documentation finding

passes.name: ownership and call graph
evidence: Authored webhook code delegates through EveChannelDispatch to the injected Eve send operation.
Installed Eve send awaits deliver or run; deliver awaits resumeHook and run awaits startWorkflowPreferLatest.
The session driver dispatches the turn child through startWorkflowPreferLatest.
No app-owned Workflow client, wrapper, queue fallback or mirrored lifecycle service exists.

passes.name: Effect quality
evidence: Unknown webhook, Eve session, config and store data cross Schema-owned boundaries once.
Public operations use named Context services, branded semantic identities, safe tagged errors, Config.schema and explicit live or memory Layers.
The inspected Channel implementation contains no unsafe cast, manual JSON reader, raw semantic id string, instanceof policy or Effect retry.
Primary Effects remain flat, lazy, linear and operation-owned.

passes.name: boundary and lifecycle correctness
evidence: The route returns 202 only after exact Eve send acceptance and atomic New or Resumed continuity convergence.
Rejected, timed out, interrupted, defective, replay-failed, observation-failed or continuity-uncertain handoff returns no 202.
Outcome-uncertain writes retain the claim and are never blindly retried.
Matching terminal settlement alone retires the continuity owner; stale settlement cannot clear a successor.

passes.name: adversarial verification
passes.result: accepted for repository and local Build Output scope
evidence: Direct fixtures cover delayed send, new and resumed acceptance, continuity fork, concurrent duplicate, rejection, timeout, defect, interruption, request abort, terminal failure, repair and stale settlement.
Packaging fixtures decode the Turbo handoff config admission, ordinary function unset duration, Workflow max duration and queue trigger.
The final complete repository verification passed ninety tooling tests, eight typechecks and fourteen workspace test tasks including seventy-three agent tests.
Preview durability and Production remain blocked rather than inferred from local or historical proof.

passes.name: documentation authority and closeout
evidence: The SPEC task ledger, active plan, architecture, app README, runbooks, thirteen-journey policy, retained packets and authority non-claims agree.
Timeout, Preview and Production tasks have terminal blocked outcomes with exact gates and no standing authority.
One stale HGI docs-path inventory finding was corrected from 187 to 190 paths before dependency closeout; HGI, docs, verification and controls rechecks passed.
This terminal detail and its local packet expand the final inventory to 192 paths without changing the accepted historical HGI receipt or any hosted outcome.
No deployment, provider, webhook, credential, message, interruption, promotion, rollback, push or merge operation occurred.

findings.observed: Three retained evidence paths made the HGI docs inventory stale at 187 paths.
findings.action: Reopened the documentation owner, corrected count and digest to 190 paths, then reran focused HGI, docs, verification and controls checks.
findings.invalidatedEvidence: No runtime or hosted packet; only the stale pre-correction inventory claim was invalidated.

rollback.hosted: No candidate was deployed; current observed Production remains older read-only context and requires its own rollback authority.

limitations: The audit accepts repository implementation and retained blocked outcomes, not hosted durability.
No candidate Preview or Production function, Workflow run, latency, interruption, provider, monitoring or rollback result exists.
External state can change after the retained read-only observation.
nonClaims: The audit grants no deployment, provider, credential, message, interruption, promotion, rollback, push or merge authority.
Local fixtures and Build Output do not prove Preview, Production, exactly-once execution, availability or every termination mode.
The audit was not rerun after each slice; this detail records the single terminal invocation and its focused finding repair.
